inv_invert_function: invert a JAX function composed of invertible primitives by tracing and reversing its JAXPR representation
register_inverse_add_primitive: register a custom inverse function for a JAX primitive not yet supported by the inversion registry
is_constant_jacobian_check: check whether a scalar JAX function has a constant Jacobian with respect to its input
log_det_scalar_compute: compute the log-determinant of the Jacobian of a scalar function using JAX autograd
review_inverse_registry: review the inverse registry mapping JAX primitives like tanh, exp, log, sqrt to their inverse operations
